education.detail: Intermediate, 1988; B.Sc discontinued, V.S. Krishna College, Visakhapatnam, 1991

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 4 of 13 cases qualify: two involve IPC 307 (attempt to murder, one alongside 326, grievous hurt by dangerous weapons); one involves IPC 409/420/468/471 (breach of trust by a public servant, cheating, forgery); one is a standalone Anti-Corruption-Bureau case under IPC 409/420. The other 9 (mostly unlawful-assembly/wrongful-restraint/public-order sections) top out under 5yr. Charges have been framed in 3 of the 13 (all non-serious ones, per section 153/153A/143); zero convictions in any case.
